text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Malta Freeport suspects sabotage in gantry engine trouble. Freeport's management is in dispute with company's engineering division after it was decided to engage subcontractors for overhaul.
- Najib Harari, 27-year-old Libyan who was at centre of Libyan extradition request turned down by Maltese court on Monday, leaves Malta for Sweden.
- Opposition leader Adami attacks Prime Minister Sant for saying government would consider granting historic fort to Order of the Knights of St John.
